purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: FORTRESS America and Military Installation Energy Independence
question: What did FORTRESS America change, and what authority, scope, financing, construction and operating-test receipts are required before major military installations actually possess independent power?
bluf: FORTRESS America is a real department-wide convergence program whose energy objective is independent power for every major U.S. military installation. The office and objective are established, but the covered-site list, meaning of independent power, critical-versus-full-load denominator, duration, technology, funding and acceptance test remain unresolved. Existing statutes, installation plans, finance authorities, microgrids and reactor pilots supply delivery lanes but do not prove fleet-wide readiness.
evidence_cutoff_note: Primary federal and service sources checked through September 30 ET. The official release controls the accessible announcement. The signed memorandum PDF remained inaccessible through browser, HTTP and PDF-reader paths; memorandum-only office wording is preserved as indexed text in official-link access-hold state and must be checked against the signed PDF before quotation. No authoritative covered-installation list, technical standard, funding total or site-level FORTRESS delivery receipt was located.
use_note: Use for the FORTRESS program, installation-power scope, authority, finance, ownership, construction and test states. Keep major installations separate from the whole estate; critical load separate from full load; annual availability separate from outage endurance; grid-connected islanding separate from permanent off-grid operation; and selection or ribbon cutting separate from accepted readiness.
entities: Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment
Assistant Secretary of War for Energy, Installations and Environment
